args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

This file implements toast notifications with an aria-live polite region for all toasts, including errors, causing delays in screen reader announcements. It also automatically dismisses toasts after five seconds, which can hide error messages. To fix, change aria-live to assertive for error toasts and disable auto-dismiss or keep error toasts visible until dismissed.
